## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4003. The issue was a **label mismatch between the Service selector and pod labels**. The new Helm chart template changed the pods to use standard Kubernetes labels (`app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`), but the Service still selects on the old label (`app: cart-service`). This broke the connection between the Service and its backend pods. The fix is to update the Service selector to use `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service` to match the new pod labels.
